linkedin:
Only 22% of remote job listings show a salary. What about the other 78%?

Most remote listings say 'DOE' (determined on experience), leaving you to guess the USD pay that matches your skills. Our latest analysis of 4,280 active listings shows:

- 940 listings (22%) disclose a concrete USD salary.
- 3,340 listings (78%) leave pay blank, implying DOE.
- 64% (2,735) accept applicants from any country.
- 1,213 listings posted in the last 7 days.

Example: Online Consumer Panels America pays $25–$45/hour for product assessments.

DOE isn't always a red flag—it can be a negotiation lever. Use global benchmarks, quantify your impact, and anchor with a range.

Browse the latest DOE listings on Loker Dollar and start the conversation today.
